entities.summary: Lance Gordon Bouma is a Canadian professional ice hockey centre who is currently playing with Dresdner Eislöwen of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). He previously played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Calgary Flames and Chicago Blackhawks.
